mutants.description: The disagreement counter measures flag_in against the fail-safe reset level RESET_VALUE instead of the believed state flag_out, so it counts time away from reset rather than time disagreeing with flag_out
mutants.reason: With the default RESET_VALUE=1, a low flag_in still qualifies and releases flag_out after RELEASE_CLKS. After that, a high flag_in clears the counter every clock instead of counting, so a real fault that holds flag_in high for any length of time never re-asserts flag_out.
